prompt: I just cloned this repo and have no idea how it's structured. Can you map it out for me?
required_behaviors: identifies entry points and modules from actual code, not guesses

prompt: Explain the architecture of this codebase before I start contributing.
required_behaviors: produces a narrative overview plus a module breakdown

prompt: Onboard me to this monorepo — what are all the packages and how do they depend on each other?
required_behaviors: maps package-level dependency graph before going deep on any one package

prompt: Document the module structure and dependencies of this Go service.
required_behaviors: identifies entry points from cmd/ and internal/ layout

prompt: Before we plan the next sprint, I want a full architectural risk register for this repo.
required_behaviors: names concrete, specific risks rather than generic boilerplate

prompt: I'm about to plan a big refactor here but I've never seen this codebase before.
required_behaviors: maps the repository before any refactor planning begins
notes: No explicit 'map' or 'architecture' keyword, but understanding must precede planning.

prompt: Where would I even start if I wanted to add multi-tenancy to this app?
required_behaviors: builds a structural understanding before recommending where to start
notes: Framed as a question about starting point, but requires the same investigation as an explicit map request.

prompt: Fix the typo in this README file.
forbidden_behaviors: running a full repository mapping workflow for a one-line edit
treating a definitional question as a request to map an actual repository

prompt: I already know this codebase well — just add a new field to the User model.
forbidden_behaviors: re-mapping a repo the user has stated they already understand
